body:
The first live daemon train completed successfully at 09:35:46Z, publishing
`21725def0609dafb1e183c4c0b150a1371b474d6`. GitHub reports both PR 580 and
PR 587 merged at 09:35:34Z. The retained publication record reports no
moved-member violations, the manifest drops no member, both claims are
released, and the runtime batch marker is `.done.json`.

The verified first-parent merges are:

- PR 580: `dab1f6526a5b11bbdfd977943d28757cc0fc47c6`, second parent
  `57da4a91db7b9336ff76705717409625f7597349`, title `[lean +41 -1]`.
- PR 587: `21725def0609dafb1e183c4c0b150a1371b474d6`, second parent
  `1086ce4c9aa5febc5d5acf026753f03757d2ce4e`, title `[lean +240 -0]`.

All eight combined CI steps passed in 436 seconds on the frozen integration
base `b73bcf2f0a3377eeb128b84b7ee7cfd0af4f505d`. The additional rooted
axiom audit passed 1662 declarations with zero failures and two existing
statement warnings. Normal publication hooks passed. The Lean deltas were
verified using the published policy, which excludes blank/comment-only lines.

The meta deployed the independently reviewed PR 595 adapter into the single
PAR=0 daemon (PID 3945934). MAIN supplied only the exact-head runtime batch
file after checking live approvals, all CI statuses, free claims and a
complete scan. The daemon owned integration and publication. MAIN spooled
its concurrent review records outside the primary tree until the train ended.

Evidence is retained under
`~/.cache/mipstarre-dev/trains/train-fqvqk1pt/` (`manifest.json` and
`publication.json`), the combined CI manifest/logs, and canonical
`results/telemetry/native-audits/train580-587-first-20260918/`.
The requirements of this issue are complete. The separate interrupted-claim
recovery follow-up in issue 589 remains outside this completion.
